=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:247-513 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The branch-tip existence check, in-flight orchestrator-run check, and workflow dispatch are not synchronized, so the purge can delete a source doc after dispatch checks it but before the new run appears in the runs list.
  WHY: The dispatched project's plan stage can then fail because its source doc is missing; reviewers disagree on severity, and the highest rating is MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh: ~443-462 (doc_exists_on_ref check) through ~507-513 (gh workflow run dispatch) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A narrow race window remains between the branch-tip contents check and the workflow dispatch call, during which the purge can delete the doc.
  WHY: The subsequently created project's plan stage reads the doc from the default branch and finds it missing, blocking the project the same way #7022 blocked; this window is acknowledged in the PR description and is a dramatic improvement from the previous hours-wide window.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
(No findings reported.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh: dispatch branch-tip loop (~lines 437-468 in the new file); in-flight-docs orchestrator-runs gate (~lines 350-373) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN's new `orchestrate_run_in_flight` gate narrows but does not eliminate the dispatch-vs-purge race because the dispatcher's `doc_exists_on_ref` read and the purge's orchestrator-runs read are independent point-in-time reads.
  WHY: `gh workflow run` can return success before the new run appears in the `/actions/runs` listing, allowing the purge to delete the doc before the orchestrator reads it and causing the project to block with "source doc unavailable."
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- `apply_analysis_on_main.sh:351-377, 443-513`; `workflow-log-analysis.yml:1270-1276` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The in-flight-doc listing and branch-tip existence check are not synchronized with the purge.
  WHY: The purge can find no active orchestrator runs, then the dispatcher can verify the doc exists before the purge deletes it; the workflows have separate concurrency groups, so the dispatcher can start the orchestrator with a doc no longer on the branch tip for planning to read.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh: in_flight_docs at lines 347-382, doc_exists_on_ref at lines 247-270, dispatch at lines 507-513 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The in-flight-docs check, branch-tip check, and workflow dispatch are not atomic, so the purge can run after the dispatcher confirms a doc exists and before the orchestrator run appears in the runs list.
  WHY: The purge may not yet see the new run, delete the doc, and cause the project's plan stage to fail with "source doc unavailable"; this reduces the race window from hours to seconds, and the reviewer considers the remaining race rare and an acceptable limitation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
